purpose: Fresh reference-blind CPU front-end after consumed V157 failed both acoustic gates. V158 changes bar/downbeat inference, Bass event formation/pitch assignment, and Guitar polyphonic pitch evidence. It is not a V157 threshold sweep, correction, filtered replacement, or rescore.

song.title: Are You Gonna Go My Way

triggerSafety.ifDuplicateRunDetected: abort V158 without scoring and move to a fresh version

timebase.principle: Beat timing and bar/downbeat phase are inferred from audio only; audio timestamp zero and any prior reference-derived shift are never musical-origin constants.

beatTracker.method: librosa beat tracking on a deterministic fused onset envelope from normalized mix plus drums
beatTracker.mapping: piecewise-linear between detected beat times; each beat spans four sixteenth steps

barPhaseModel.method: four-state sequential Viterbi bar-position model over tracked beats
emissionFeatures: drums onset-strength robust z-score at beat
normalized-mix onset-strength robust z-score at beat
bass-stem onset-strength robust z-score at beat
low-frequency spectral-flux robust z-score at beat
harmonic chroma-change novelty from the normalized mix at beat
barPhaseModel.downbeatEmission: state 0 receives deterministic positive evidence from combined drum/mix/low-frequency accent plus harmonic-change novelty; non-downbeat states receive neutral baseline plus cyclic transition evidence
barPhaseModel.tieBreak: lowest state index then earliest path

timebase.leadingGrid: after Viterbi state inference, extrapolate complete four-beat bars backward using robust early local beat period only until earliest detected musical activity is nonnegative on the grid
timebase.quantization: preserve startSeconds and rawGridStep, then deterministically snap to nearest integer sixteenth

bassRecognition.architecture: onset-first attacks with soft-F0 plus harmonic-template fundamental/octave inference

onsetCreation.principle: each distinct detected onset is an event proposal before pitch assignment; pYIN voicing is never allowed to erase an onset proposal

harmonicTemplate.analysisSignal: bass stem plus HPSS harmonic component
harmonicTemplate.octaveComparison: explicitly compare candidate, candidate-12 and candidate+12 when in range using the same harmonic-template score; choose highest score with lower-MIDI tie break

pitchEvidence.fusion: combine normalized harmonic-template score with pYIN pitch proximity weighted by pYIN voiced probability; if pYIN is unavailable/unvoiced, harmonic-template evidence alone assigns pitch

bassRecognition.duration: event end is next retained onset or harmonic-energy decay, whichever is earlier; duration does not determine whether an onset exists

guitarRecognition.architecture: Basic Pitch proposals plus multi-frame harmonic-template tracking and register repair; no raw onset-local CQT-only completion

harmonicTracker.signal: HPSS harmonic component of guitar stem
proposalSources: persistent local harmonic-template track at independently detected guitar onset
harmonicTracker.registerRepair: for every proposal compare original MIDI and +/-12 candidates in range using multi-frame harmonic-template fit; replace register only when an alternate has strictly greater deterministic template fit and a present fundamental bin
harmonicTracker.sparsePursuit: at each onset iteratively choose non-overlapping harmonic templates against residual spectral energy, subtract selected template contribution, stop at six notes or when no candidate has positive residual-template gain

guitarRecognition.fusion: Basic Pitch proposals are tracked/validated across frames; persistent harmonic-template tracks may add polyphonic proposals, but single-frame onset-local CQT peaks may not create notes

postProcessing.deduplicateSameStream: same MIDI and same snapped absolute grid step collapse to one event with deterministic evidence precedence

mustPassBeforeFreeze: exact dependency/model identities and deterministic CPU environment
all events finite and within preregistered MIDI ranges
all snapped steps integer 0..15 and consistent with absoluteGridStep
beat times strictly increasing and Viterbi bar-state path length equals beat count
every Bass generated event traces to a retained onset proposal
no Guitar source label corresponding to free-standing single-frame CQT completion

failurePolicy: Any duplicate generation, structural-QC failure after candidate creation, or missed score gate freezes the failure and ends V158. Never repair/retune/select a replacement V158 candidate against professional reference. Pure setup failures before candidate creation may only be repaired if architecture/preregistration semantics remain unchanged and doing so does not violate the single-generation-run rule.
